description: This header file declares functions, structures, and external variables for network interface operations such as IP address management, MAC address handling, interface status, and PPPoE control within an OS abstraction layer.

methods.name: os_nif_exists
methods.description: Checks if a network interface exists.

methods.name: os_nif_ipaddr_get
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_netmask_get
methods.description: Retrieves the netmask of a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_bcast_get
methods.description: Retrieves the broadcast address of a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_ipaddr_set
methods.description: Sets the IP address of a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_netmask_set
methods.description: Sets the netmask of a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_bcast_set
methods.description: Sets the broadcast address of a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_mtu_get
methods.description: Retrieves the MTU of a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_mtu_set
methods.description: Sets the MTU of a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_gateway_set
methods.description: Sets the gateway address for a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_gateway_del
methods.description: Deletes the gateway address for a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_macaddr
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_macaddr_get
methods.description: Gets the MAC address of a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_macaddr_set
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_up
methods.description: Brings a network interface up or down.

methods.name: os_nif_is_up
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is up.

methods.name: os_nif_is_running
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is running.

methods.name: os_nif_softwds_create
methods.description: Creates a softwds interface.

methods.name: os_nif_softwds_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a softwds interface.

methods.name: os_nif_list_get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of network interfaces.

methods.name: os_nif_list_free
methods.description: Frees the list of network interfaces.

methods.name: os_nif_br_add
methods.description: Adds a bridge to a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_br_del
methods.description: Removes a bridge from a network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_ipaddr_from_str
methods.description: Converts a string to an IP address.

methods.name: os_nif_macaddr_from_str
methods.description: Converts a string to a MAC address.

methods.name: os_nif_macaddr_to_str
methods.description: Converts a MAC address to a string.

methods.name: os_nif_pppoe_pidof
methods.description: Gets the process ID of a PPPoE session.

methods.name: os_nif_pppoe_start
methods.description: Starts a PPPoE session.

methods.name: os_nif_pppoe_stop
methods.description: Stops a PPPoE session.

methods.name: os_nif_is_interface_ready
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is ready.

methods.name: os_nif_ioctl
methods.description: Performs an ioctl operation on a network interface.
